excl.s: Big Tech earnings and Anthropic's mid-November IPO will test investor appetite for AI; Ramp data shows a record 8% of firms switched AI providers in September.
New Ramp data shows AI spend growth slowed sharply over the past two months; Ramp's economist points to falling prices for frontier models.
Total AI spend on Ramp is falling even as token volumes rise, as OpenAI and Anthropic compete on price. Top-1% spend per employee fell nearly 10% from July to August.

items.t: US economy grows at a brisk 3.4% pace in the third quarter
items.s: Third-quarter GDP accelerated to a 3.4% annualized rate, powered by solid consumer spending and heavy AI investment.

items.t: US jobless claims slide to 194,000, lowest since mid-July

items.t: US inflation heats up in September as consumer spending rises
